name: Storm
description: Cross-venue prediction-market arbitrage feed from Eyewall Markets. Free tools surface the public spread tape; bind to a Storm account for personal watchlist push alerts (Pro) or the full read API (Edge).

baseUrl.description: Override the Storm API base URL. Defaults to https://eyewallmarkets.com.

skillToken.description: Bearer token issued by /skill/bind-confirm. Persisted by the user after they complete the email-link bind flow.
